title: Corona Heritage Museum

services.name: Schedule Tours
services.desc: Schedule a docent-led private tour for groups. Perfect for Educational field trips, community groups, etc. Hundreds of CNUSD visit us yearly! Minors: Children under 18 must be with an adult. Groups require the appropriate number of chaperones. Discover Corona's history, including mining and citrus development, with artifacts collected over 40 years and donated by and from citizens of Corona and beyond. Thousands of artifacts span the space. Immerse in an HO scale layout showcasing rail lines from Fullerton to Riverside to Corona as they were in the citrus hey-day of 1949. blurb: The Corona Heritage Museum collection consists of thousands of objects and artifacts donated ​by present and former residents of the City of Corona since the museum opened in 2000. Included are household furnishings, clothing and accessories, tools, toys, art, photographs and documents. Some items are included as part of our permanent exhibits; others are featured in our rotating exhibits.
